label: Touch
description: Spell affects a target that must be touched. No range cost modifier.

label: Target
description: Spell affects a single target at range. Caster makes a Spell test; target may resist.

label: Area (Z metres)
description: Spell affects all targets in a Z-metre radius. Cost increases with Z per RAW area table.

label: On Target
description: Spell is placed at the caster's chosen point within range rather than on a specific actor.
